newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Texwinca sets HK$120 million loan.
newsitem.headline: Texwinca sets HK$120 million loan.

text.p: Hong Kong fabric dyeing and knitting group Texwinca Holdings has set a HK$120 million loan facility, said arranger and underwriter American Express Bank.
The issue has been underwritten by American Express Bank and Fuji Bank.
The amortizing loan has a three-year final maturity and an average life of 2.5 years. It pays a margin of 120 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Banks have been invited to participate at three levels.

Fees are 57 basis points for lead managers committing to HK$21-25 million for an all-in return of 142.8 basis points, 50 basis points for co-lead managers committing to HK$15-20 million for an all-in return of 140 basis points and 43 basis points for managers committing to HK$10-15 million for an all-in return of 137.2 basis points.
Syndication is expected to be completed this week.
